svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

g.text: Untreated plate on a slab on ground:
0.05 mm polyethylene or Type S roll roofing, (1)

svg.text: Except as permitted in Sentence (2), wood
framing members that are not pressure-treated

supported on concrete in contact with the

This dampproofing is not required where the
wood member is at least 150 mm (5⅞″) above the
Drawn: separation layer shown thick so it can be seen, treated wood tinted green. Sizes are illustration only.
